lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in a semi-regular grid of vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, showing a consistent spatial frequency across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a distinct checkerboard-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily towards the leading edge and base of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes (remoras) located in the ventral water column below the pectoral fin and abdominal region.
